description: USD stablecoin pegs — USDC, USDT, DAI, PYUSD, USDe, FDUSD and USDS — checked against $1 across independent public sources: Kraken, Coinbase and Gemini USD order books, CoinGecko's aggregate price, and Gate's FDUSD/USDT book converted at the USDT/USD rate. For each coin: the median price, deviation from $1 in bps, a severity flag (on_peg < 25 bps, watch < 50, depeg < 200, severe_depeg beyond), how far the sources disagree, and every quote with its spread and volume. Sources that fail are listed under errors; the call fails (and is not charged) only if none answers. Costs $0.002 USDC per call.
